description: Read log entries for one deployment by owner/deployment or a bare slug (owner defaults to the account owner). severity is passed through to the server unvalidated (illustrative values: DEBUG, INFO, NOTICE, WARNING, ERROR, CRITICAL, ALERT, EMERGENCY); an invalid value returns the server's own rejection message. limit defaults to 50, max 200. nextPageToken pages through older entries.

deployment.description: Deployment ref by owner/deployment or a bare slug.

pageToken.description: Pagination token from a previous call's nextPageToken.

severity.description: Comma-separated log severity levels, passed through unvalidated (e.g. INFO or WARNING,ERROR). Exact match, not a minimum threshold.

name: deployment_logs
